quote: Every driver of a vehicle approaching a stop intersection indicated by a stop sign shall stop before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection or, if there is no crosswalk, shall stop at a clearly marked stop line, or if none, then at the point nearest the intersecting highway where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the intersecting highway before entering the intersection.

activation.description: Driver approaches a stop intersection indicated by a governing stop sign

obligation.description: Stop before the near-side crosswalk; if absent, before the clearly marked stop line; if both absent, at the nearest point with a view of approaching intersecting traffic before entering the intersection

timing.description: The full vehicle body must halt before the applicable reference and before intersection entry

parameter_refs.name: near_side_crosswalk_present
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: true in this selected branch; other statutory alternatives require separate cases

parameter_refs.name: requested_pre_crosswalk_stop
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: true or false; request is not measured behavior
